title: Finalizer transfer phase
statement: Fix a mode, a Boolean input word $x$, an allowed input-head position $p$, and Boolean words $a$, $c$, $r$, and $u$ such that $c=ur$. Start the finalizer in state $3$ with the capture tape storing $c$ from cell $0$ and its head at $|u|$, the argument head at $|u|$ in install mode and at $0$ in emit mode, and output $u$ in install mode and empty in emit mode; the argument tape stores $a$ in emit mode and $u$ in install mode. After exactly $|r|+1$ steps it is in state $4$, with the capture tape still storing $c$ and its head at $|c|-1$, the argument head at $|c|-1$ in install mode and at $0$ in emit mode, and output $c$ in emit mode and empty in install mode; the argument tape stores $c$ in install mode and $a$ in emit mode.
replaced:
Let the finalizer run on an argument word $a$ and capture word $c$, and write $c$ as a
processed prefix $p$ followed by a remainder $r$. Starting from its transfer state with
the capture head at $|p|$ -- having already transferred $p$ to the argument tape
(install mode) or the output (emit mode) -- after exactly $|r| + 1$ steps it is in the
erasure state with the full capture transferred: the argument tape holds $c$ in install
mode and $a$ in emit mode, the output holds $c$ exactly in emit mode, and the capture
word itself is still intact.
